synthetic_notice: All claims, records, values, citations, and DOIs in this report are synthetic demonstration fixtures. The DOIs are deliberately non-resolving placeholders and are not publications.

claim_review.before_claim: H-07 is universally effective, completely safe, and clinically ready.
claim_review.available_support: Frozen synthetic technical-well means from one fictional batch.
claim_review.risk: A synthetic in vitro proxy cannot support universal, safety, efficacy, or clinical-readiness claims.
claim_review.after_claim: The values illustrate retrospective ranking within this fixture, not safety, efficacy, mechanism, or clinical performance.

claim_review.before_claim: The workflow was fully autonomous and closed loop.
claim_review.available_support: All 18 rows existed before fitting; no subsequent experiment was selected or run.
claim_review.risk: Retrospective holdout ranking was mislabeled as adaptive experimentation.
claim_review.after_claim: The workflow is retrospective rather than closed loop because no result changed a subsequent experimental choice.

claim_review.before_claim: A 78.4% bacterial-signal reduction proves bactericidal activity, and 90.3% viability proves biocompatibility.
claim_review.available_support: Two deterministic, fictional endpoint means with no independent batch or well-level variance.
claim_review.risk: Descriptive proxy values were converted into biological conclusions.
claim_review.after_claim: H-07 has frozen synthetic outcomes of 78.4% reduction and 90.3% viability; these descriptive values do not establish independent-experiment superiority or organism-level tolerability.

claim_review.before_claim: The in vitro difference caused superior wound healing.
claim_review.available_support: No wound-healing endpoint, animal study, intervention comparison, or causal design exists.
claim_review.risk: A causal clinical outcome was invented from an in vitro proxy.

claim_review.before_claim: The model achieved state-of-the-art accuracy and generalized across the entire hydrogel design space [3].
claim_review.available_support: No benchmark, accuracy metric, external split, or reference 3 was supplied in the input.
claim_review.risk: The citation was missing and the comparison and generalization domains were undefined.

claim_review.before_claim: The result is unprecedented and the first AI-designed hydrogel.
claim_review.available_support: No literature search or priority evidence exists.
claim_review.risk: An unsupported novelty claim was presented as fact.

verification.reason: The identifiers are visibly labeled synthetic placeholders. Querying Crossref would add no scientific verification and could imply that they were intended as real citations.

limitations: Structural citation checks do not establish entailment.
The after manuscript is internally coherent as a demo, not scientifically validated.
Placeholder citations must be replaced and verified before adapting any structure to a real manuscript.
